unique_recovered_mechanism.definition: Speak one continuous passage and derive visual focus from speech boundary charIndex events rather than from a fixed timer or one-utterance-per-unit lifecycle.
potential_value: Preserves continuous speech prosody while visual focus follows actual spoken timing.
Avoids assuming fixed dwell equals spoken duration.
Could compare auditory and visual temporal alignment directly.
risks: Speech boundary-event support and granularity vary by browser/voice.
2018 whitespace segmentation is weaker than current Intl.Segmenter/manual segmentation.
Direct transplant would regress provenance/RETURN and local-voice fallback behavior.

decision.reason: Verse Atlas and Sleeper have different causal jobs; Painting Path already has a stronger modern reader kernel. The unique boundary clock is worth preserving as an optional experimental clock, not replacing current behavior.
